description: YSR Pension Kanuka, part of Navarathnalu, health, education and Swachh Bharat employees under the department of urban development and municipal administration are using the FR-based attendance system in Andhra Pradesh.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh deploys facial recognition, geofencing technologies across state; 1 crore faces recorded daily YSR Pension Kanuka, part of Navarathnalu, health, education and Swachh Bharat employees under the department of urban development and municipal administration are using the FR-based attendance system in Andhra Pradesh.
